title: Woodshed — Yasnaya Polyana
source: Museum panoramas and retained Protomaps courtyard context

nativeAxes.x: Low end northeast toward the high louvered end
nativeAxes.z: Boarded front southeast toward the courtyard

identityStatus: Two views in the museum exterior tour place the boarded shed beside the white garden wall, west of the White Kitchen. The high louver end faces northeast. The photo rays use two White Kitchen eave corners and the rear of Tolstoy House to align the photos to the aerial view. The native PMTiles lacks the shed outline and supplies independent path and building context.
